strings.HTTP autoindex 为只读协议，不支持上传: HTTP autoindex is read-only — uploading is not supported
strings.HTTP autoindex 为只读协议，不支持远程间传输: HTTP autoindex is read-only — remote-to-remote transfer is not supported
strings.HTTP → SFTP 暂不支持: HTTP → SFTP is not supported yet
strings.HTTP 文件不支持在线预览：双击可用浏览器打开: HTTP files cannot be previewed inline: double-click to open in the browser
strings.HTTP 目录为只读，不能重命名远程条目；可在标签视图中为其设置显示别名: HTTP folders are read-only; remote items cannot be renamed — set a display alias in the tag view instead

strings.主题包已自带配色: Theme pack ships its own colors
strings.保存到已安装主题包并选用: Save to installed theme pack and apply
strings.保存将覆盖已安装的同名主题: Saving will overwrite the installed theme with the same name
strings.卸载后 nfs:// 地址将无法访问，插件文件将从本机删除。: After uninstalling, nfs:// addresses will no longer work and the plugin files will be removed from this machine.
strings.安装包来自官方 GitHub Release，经 sha256 与协议版本校验后: Installers come from the official GitHub Release and are saved only after sha256 and protocol-version checks.
strings.已安装同名主题「{id}」，确定覆盖？: An installed theme named "{id}" already exists. Overwrite?
strings.当前配色修改将被新起点覆盖，确定切换？: Current color edits will be overwritten by the new base. Switch anyway?
strings.插件以独立进程运行，安装或更新后无需重启应用。: The plugin runs in its own process — no app restart needed after installing or updating.
strings.整体旋转主题色系；文件夹 / 成功 / 危险色不跟随: Rotate the theme palette overall; folder / success / danger colors stay fixed
strings.文件超过 30MB，显示缩略图（「外部打开」查看原图）: File exceeds 30 MB — showing thumbnail (use "Open externally" for the original)
strings.无法解析为 oklch，只能直接编辑原值: Can't parse as oklch — only the raw value can be edited directly
strings.未保存的配色修改将丢弃，确定关闭？: Unsaved color edits will be discarded. Close anyway?
strings.未知类型，按纯文本预览: Unknown type — previewing as plain text
strings.疑似二进制文件，不支持按文本预览: Looks like a binary file — can't preview as text
Browse and read/write files on remote servers; passwords are encrypted with the master key, private keys stay in ~/.ssh
strings.解析 nginx autoindex 页面为文件 / 文件夹列表，支持上下层 U: Parses nginx autoindex pages into file / folder lists, with up/down URL navigation (read-only browsing)
strings.把当前窗口目录分享为链接：他人浏览器只读浏览 + Range 断点续传下载；支持: Shares the current window's directory as a link: others browse read-only in their browser + resumable downloads via Range; with parent-directory toggle, connection cap and expiry
strings.地址栏 smb://host/share 或 \\\\host\\share 浏: Browse Windows shares via smb://host/share or \\host\share in the address bar: UNC delegated to the local engine, authentication uses system credentials; smb://host lists shares (Windows only)
strings.地址栏 nfs://host/export 直连 NFSv3 导出（纯 Rust: Connect directly to NFSv3 exports via nfs://host/export in the address bar (pure Rust client, no system mount): browse with read/write, recursive upload/download; nfs://host lists exports
strings.经 .rdplugin 安装的 NFSv3 伴生进程插件（设置 → 插件安装后生: NFSv3 companion-process plugin installed via .rdplugin (takes effect after installing under Settings → Plugins): connect to exports directly via nfs://host/export in the address bar, browse with read/write, recursive upload/download
strings.右键自定义打开方式：用户自行注册工具，参数数组安全启动: Custom "Open with" from the context menu: register your own tools, launched safely via argument arrays
strings.在文件夹/空白处右键打开终端（mac Terminal/iTerm/fish/n: Open a terminal from the right-click menu on folders / blank space (mac Terminal/iTerm/fish/nu/zsh, win wt/powershell/cmd/fish/nu)
strings.路径栏输入命令：PATH 可执行扫描补全，回车在终端中 cd 到当前目录执行: Type commands in the path bar: executable PATH scan with completion; Enter cds to the current directory and runs in the terminal
strings.web 模式暂只支持拖拽上传到本地窗格: Web mode currently only supports drag-and-drop upload to local panes
strings.会话已随使用自动保存，程序意外中断后下次启动会恢复最近布局。「保存并退出」立即保: Sessions are saved automatically as you work; if the app exits unexpectedly, the most recent layout is restored on next launch. "Save and quit" saves the current layout immediately; "Don't save" clears the saved session and next launch returns to the default page.
strings.SFTP 远程目录需验证主密钥后恢复，否则显示占位。: SFTP remote folders are restored only after master-key verification; otherwise a placeholder is shown.
strings.展开侧边栏后查看远程服务器（{key}）: Expand the sidebar to browse remote servers ({key})
strings.SFTP 文件按服务器分目录存放（sftp/主机名），也用于 SFTP 之间互传: SFTP files are stored in per-server folders (sftp/hostname); this folder also stages transfers between SFTP servers and is cleaned up automatically on exit.
strings.文件较大，仅预览前 256 KB，完整内容请用外部应用打开: File is large — only the first 256 KB is previewed; open it in an external app for the full content
strings.文件含非 {enc} 字节，按近似字符显示: File contains bytes outside {enc}; shown with approximate characters
strings.已按 {enc} 解码（Windows 记事本 / PowerShell 写出的: Decoded as {enc} (the encoding Windows Notepad / PowerShell commonly writes)
strings.非 UTF-8 文本，已按 {enc} 解码（繁体 / 日文等其他编码可能显示为: Non-UTF-8 text, decoded as {enc} (other encodings such as Traditional Chinese / Japanese may show wrong glyphs)
strings.SFTP 未连接（需要主密钥验证）: SFTP not connected (master key verification required)
strings.删除服务器配置「{name}」？连接不会断开。: Delete server config "{name}"? The connection stays open.
strings.已导出 {n} 台服务器（含加密密码，导入时需输入主密码）: Exported {n} servers (passwords encrypted; the master password is required on import)
strings.远程临时目录已是空的: The remote temp folder is already empty
strings.当前已是最新版本 v{ver}: Already on the latest version v{ver}
strings.收藏已更新为当前布局: Favorite updated to the current layout
strings.已开启同步比对：左右窗格联动导航（{combo} 查看结果）: Sync compare on: the two panes navigate together ({combo} to view results)
strings.已更新显示名（HTTP 目录为只读，不改远程本体）: Display name updated (HTTP folders are read-only; the remote itself is unchanged)
strings.（web 模式：请输入服务端机器上的路径）: (web mode: enter a path on the server machine)
strings.主题包 id 无效（小写字母/数字/连字符，≤64 字符）: Invalid theme pack id (lowercase letters/digits/hyphens, ≤64 chars)
strings.主题包缺少名称: Theme pack is missing a name
strings.丢弃快照，从磁盘重新全量构建（期间旧索引继续可查）: Discard snapshot and rebuild everything from disk (old index stays searchable meanwhile)
strings.保存后范围/排除变化会自动触发重新构建；外部变更由实时监视秒级同步（监视不可用时: Saving scope/exclusion changes automatically triggers a rebuild; external changes sync within seconds via live watching (falls back to routine scans when unavailable). The first build may take a few minutes — keep working as usual meanwhile.
strings.全盘索引检索（Everything 级瞬时返回；需在 设置 → 插件 开启，索引: Full-disk index search (Everything-grade instant results; enable in Settings → Plugins, scope in Settings → Full-disk index)
strings.全盘索引检索（输入文件名片段，瞬时返回）…: Search the full-disk index (type part of a filename, instant results)…
strings.后台索引本地固定卷，文件名检索 Everything 级瞬时返回：默认关闭，启用: Indexes local fixed volumes in the background; filename search returns instantly at Everything grade: off by default; once enabled it builds in idle time with second-level incremental updates; scope and exclusions in Settings → Full-disk index
strings.后台索引本地磁盘文件名，搜索面板点亮「全盘」即瞬时检索。启用开关在「插件」分区（: Indexes local disk filenames in the background; light up "Global" in the search panel for instant results. The on/off switch lives in the Plugins section (off by default).
strings.实时监视（外部新增/删除/改名秒级进索引）: Live watch (external add/delete/rename enters the index within seconds)
strings.实时监视：已开启（外部变更秒级自动同步）: Live watch: on (external changes sync automatically within seconds)
strings.实时监视：降级（周期扫描兜底，检查磁盘访问权限）: Live watch: degraded (routine scans as fallback; check disk access permission)
strings.排除目录（每行一个，含其全部子内容）: Excluded dirs (one per line, includes all children)
strings.排除目录名（每行一个名字，对任意层级下的同名目录生效，如 node_module: Excluded dir names (one per line; matches same-named dirs at any depth, e.g. node_modules)
strings.排除的类型（每行一个扩展名，如 log）: Types to exclude (one extension per line, e.g. log)
strings.仅索引的类型（每行一个扩展名，如 md；无扩展名文件不会被索引）: Types to index (one extension per line, e.g. md; extension-less files will not be indexed)
strings.扩展名不含点，多级扩展名（如 tar.gz）填最后一段 gz: Extensions without the dot; for multi-part ones (e.g. tar.gz) enter the last part gz
strings.未启用（在「插件」分区开启）: Not enabled (turn on in the Plugins section)
strings.目录未变化时的重扫是零成本 stat；外部变更由实时监视秒级捕获，无需调高频率: Rescans of unchanged dirs cost nothing (metadata stat only); external changes are caught within seconds by live watching — no need to raise the frequency
strings.索引未启用（设置 → 插件 → 全盘索引搜索）: Index not enabled (Settings → Plugins → Full-disk search)
strings.输入关键词全盘检索: Type to search the whole disk
strings.选择目录加入索引范围: Pick a directory to add to the scope
strings.递归层数上限（不限 = 一直递归到底）: Max recursion depth (unlimited = recurse all the way down)
strings.已注册：目录 / 目录空白处 / 文件右键「用 R-Dir 打开」: Registered: folders, folder background and files show “Open with R-Dir” in the context menu
strings.注册后：右键目录 / 目录空白处「用 R-Dir 打开」直达该目录；右键文件在已: Once registered: right-click a folder or the folder background → “Open with R-Dir” opens it directly; right-click a file to open it in the running R-Dir as a new tab and reveal it. Written to the current-user registry (HKCU), no admin required; already-open windows pick it up without restart.
strings.当前平台无需运行时注册。: No runtime registration needed on this platform.
strings.macOS：文件右键「打开方式 → R-Dir」、目录 / 文件拖到 Dock: macOS: right-click a file → “Open With → R-Dir”, or drag folders / files onto the Dock icon to open them in R-Dir (a new tab when already running). Windows installers register automatically; toggle here anytime.
strings.关闭不常用的菜单组，让文件右键菜单更清爽；「快捷链接」（创建快捷方式 / 发送到: Turn off rarely used menu groups to keep the file context menu tidy; “Quick links” (create shortcut / send to desktop) is off by default and only applies to local paths once enabled.
strings.快捷链接（创建快捷方式 / 发送到桌面）: Quick links (create shortcut / send to desktop)
strings.比较时忽略匹配的文本（如日志时间戳），每行一条正则: Ignore matching text when comparing (e.g. log timestamps), one regex per line
strings.比较时忽略匹配的文本（每行一条正则，同时应用于两侧）；应用后重新比较: Ignore matching text when comparing (one regex per line, applied to both sides); re-compares on apply
strings.忽略行首到首次出现: Ignore line start up to first occurrence of
strings.生成「忽略行首到首次出现该分隔符为止」的正则；行内不含分隔符的行不受影响: Generates a regex ignoring everything from line start to the first occurrence of the separator; lines without the separator are unaffected
strings.预设（点击追加到左侧）: Presets (click to append on the left)
strings.可能误伤恰好 10/13 位的普通数字（如长 ID），仅确认日志为 Epoch: May false-match ordinary 10/13-digit numbers (e.g. long IDs); enable only if the log really uses Epoch time
strings.修改正则忽略将丢弃未保存的修改: Changing the ignore regex will discard unsaved changes
strings.正则忽略会按新规则重新比较两侧文件，未保存的编辑（含已应用的补丁）将被丢弃。: The ignore regex re-compares both files under the new rules; unsaved edits (including applied patches) will be discarded.
strings.（覆盖将合并同名目录，内部同名文件将被覆盖）: (Overwriting merges the folders — files with matching names inside will be overwritten)

errors.INDEX_DISABLED: Full-disk index is disabled — enable it under Settings → Plugins
